name: Inpweb Visitor Counter
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inpweb Visitor Counter is a professional-grade analytical tool designed for WordPress site owners who need clean, reliable data. Unlike standard counters that inflate numbers with bot traffic, Inpweb uses a “Human-First” engine to provide an accurate picture of your real audience.

It provides a high-impact dashboard to monitor your traffic while automatically filtering out malicious crawlers and spiders.

Key Features:
* Intelligent Anti-Bot Filter: Advanced detection of 20+ bot patterns (Google, Bing, Facebook, etc.) to ensure your data is 100% human.
* Visitor Geolocation: Automatically identifies the country of origin for every unique visitor.
* Granular Visibility Control: Choose exactly which pages or posts will display the public “Social Proof” counter.
* Professional Dashboard: A sleek, 3-column command center with real-time global activity simulation.
* Forensic Data Export: Download comprehensive CSV reports for external analysis or client reporting.
* Privacy Focused: Lightweight and compliant. We don’t store sensitive PII data.

External Services

This plugin uses the following third-party service to provide visitor geolocation:

  • IP-API (ip-api.com): This service is used to identify the country of a visitor based on their IP address. This helps site owners understand their audience distribution.
  • Service URL: http://ip-api.com/
  • Terms & Privacy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal

Note: Only the anonymized IP address is sent to the API for lookup. No other site data is shared.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-visitor-counter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Your analytics dashboard will appear under the ‘Inp-Counter’ menu in your sidebar.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Security Patch: Improved IP validation and sanitization for PHP 8.2+.
  • Stability Fix: Corrected database table creation logic to prevent critical errors.
  • SEO Update: Enhanced description and tags for better repository visibility.
  • External Service Disclosure: Added required technical disclosure for IP-API usage.

1.0.9

  • Initial stable release.
  • Added CSV Export functionality.
  • Implemented transient-based caching for API calls.
